name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-copilot-toolbox
title: Copilot Toolbox
shortDescription: Creates and maintains a SharePoint-based toolbox for discovering, documenting, reviewing, and synchronizing Copilot tools.
longDescription: Copilot Toolbox creates a SharePoint list that acts as a local handbook for the tools available to Copilot in SharePoint.

The skill discovers the current tool catalog, enriches each tool with usage guidance and parameters, tracks new and removed tools, supports a review workflow, and safely synchronizes existing records.
It also creates a Toolbox.aspx page and can publish an English HTML Toolbook as a standalone reference.

references.name: agentskills.io specification
references.description: The specification that SharePoint AI skills follow for installation and discovery.
